items.headline: Houthi drone attack on Riyadh tower injures 11
items.summary: Saudi authorities said two Saudis and nine foreign nationals were hurt in the attack on a building in Riyadh's financial district.

items.headline: Hormuz oil traffic down 40% as tanker attacks increase
items.summary: Al Jazeera looks at whether Iran's attacks on tankers are achieving their aim as oil flows through the strait drop sharply.

items.headline: Iraq orders takeover of oilfields in Kurdish-controlled areas
items.summary: Baghdad ordered control of oilfields in areas run by Kurdish authorities to be handed over.

items.headline: FTSE 100 slips as metal prices hit miners
items.summary: The index fell 0.1% to 10,467.07 on Tuesday, while the FTSE 250 dropped 0.8% to 23,858.88.
items.source: Alliance News via Yahoo Finance, 24 Nov

items.headline: Anthropic shares slump below their IPO price
items.summary: The shares fell about 7% on Tuesday, raising questions about investor appetite for highly valued AI companies.

items.headline: Compass considers US primary listing as Kingfisher raises outlook
items.summary: The catering group is looking at moving its main listing to the US, while B&Q owner Kingfisher upgraded its forecast.

items.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Ship agents for code changes
items.summary: The set of agents reviews, fixes and approves code; a new PR Steward agent repairs failing checks and merge conflicts.

items.headline: Huang's return adds nearly $1tn to Nvidia's value
items.summary: The company's value jumped by nearly a trillion dollars in a day after his reinstatement, even as Congress and investigators keep up pressure.

items.headline: NHS launches AI breast cancer screening trial
items.summary: The trial will test whether AI can help spot breast cancer earlier.
